note: Golden fixture for the phone's facts text encoder (towervec MiniLM-L12, 384-d) and the towervec head. Made by eval/cascade_port/encoder_golden.py from PUBLIC dev data only (dev libraries 14798958@N08, 23090753@N06; writer lines p2b_all + repeat-stop v2; recorded dev scorer questions). kind=real: the photo's own place/taken and line, text verified equal to the cluster's facts parquet; kind=synthetic: an edge case, see name/note.
how_to_check: For every facts entry: ids_device = BertTokenizer(vocab.txt of towervec_encoder_fp16).factsInput(text) must equal ids (questions: questionInput(question)); vector_device = mean over all tokens of BertModel(ids, tokenTypeIds zeros, attention mask ones).hiddenStates (no normalisation). PASS if cosine(vector_device, fp32) >= 0.9999 for EVERY text (mlx_fp16 = what MLX fp16 gave on CPU; the device runs fp16 on Metal, so expect it about as far from fp32 as mlx_fp16 is, not bit-equal to mlx_fp16; omitting tokenTypeIds gave cosine min .72 / mean .93 in RESULTS 68). Then for every pair: P_device = ScorerHead(towervec_head.fphead).fold(q: device vector of questions[question], t: questions[question].t).p(f: device vector of facts[fact], v: facts[fact].v). PASS if |P_device - p| <= p_bar for EVERY pair; report the max. p_bar = 0.004: the requested 0.001 is smaller than what fp16 alone does to P (MLX fp16 on CPU vs the fp32 reference: max 1.63e-03 on this file's 26 pairs, max 1.60e-03 over 8091 (photo, question) pairs heads.py recorded for 200 seeded photos of each of these two libraries, 14 of them over 1e-3, 0 on the other side of P = .7), so p_bar = 2 x that maximum, rounded up. Linux (FactsEncoderGoldenTests.swift) checks ids, prefixes and the head on this file's own vectors.
pooling: mean over ALL tokens incl. [CLS]/[SEP] of the last hidden state, not normalised; token_type_ids 0; mask 1; facts [CLS]+ids[:254]+[SEP], question [CLS]+ids[:64]+[SEP]; no padding
reference_fp32: ORIGINAL weights eval/facts_scorer/models/tvw_t2b_final_rs2_xfit_full/weights.pt (enc.*) via eval/facts_scorer/scorers.py Scorer, PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130 fp32 CPU, one unpadded sequence at a time
reference_mlx_fp16: MLX 0.32.3 (Python, CPU backend), hidden states mlx.core.float16; weights eval/cascade_port/models/towervec_encoder_fp16/model.safetensors (= the app's bundled copy), fp16 compute, mean in fp16 then fp32
tokenizer: Hugging Face fast tokenizer of sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L12-v2 (what the scorers used)
p_reference: scorers.Head (towervec, from the same weights.pt as the .fphead) in fp32 PyTorch CPU on the ROUNDED fp32 vectors of this file; p_mlx = the same head on mlx_fp16 vectors; p_cluster = heads.py's recorded fp32 P for that (photo, question) (batched vectors), null for edge cases
